rich_narrative.summary: Qalam Education Fund provides accessible Islamic knowledge through dedicated education, mentorship, and community programs [11]. Founded in <cite id="11">2009</cite>, the Texas-based institution focuses on three primary pillars: Ta'leem (sacred knowledge education), Tarbiya (personal growth), and Suhba (community companionship) [11]. The organization delivers its curriculum through initiatives like the Qalam Seminary and Roots Community [11]. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $2,329,468</cite> while maintaining a high <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 82.6%</cite> [3]. The charity is officially <cite id="2">ZAKAT-ELIGIBLE</cite>, collecting funds directly for religious education and student support [2]. Despite financial efficiency in program spending, the organization maintains substantial reserves equal to <cite id="1">109.7 months of working capital</cite> [1]. Over recent years, Qalam has expanded its operational footprint across the United States [11]. Financially, the charity achieved a <cite id="3">3-Year Revenue CAGR of 22.8%</cite> [3]. Its overall fundraising model remains extremely low-cost, requiring <cite id="1"><$0.01 per $1 raised</cite> in charitable contributions [1].
